title: Domains & DNS
summary: Understand the domain control-plane model, DNS verification, routing, TLS, and safe domain migration.

sections.heading: Central domain control plane
body: Velclaw exposes a domain control plane for domain, DNS, nameserver, and hosting state. Domain status should be tracked independently from deployment status.
The application model includes domain states such as active, pending, and attention so operational issues can be surfaced without hiding them behind a generic success state.

sections.heading: DNS before production
body: Before making a domain canonical, verify ownership and DNS control. DNS records must point to the intended production target and the target must serve valid HTTPS.
Do not treat a domain as live merely because a DNS record exists; verify resolution, routing, certificate state, and the application response separately.

sections.heading: Safe domain migration
body: A domain migration is a coordinated change. Update deployment configuration, OAuth/CORS, metadata, canonical URLs, redirects, and search properties together when applicable.
Keep the existing canonical domain until ownership and DNS control of the replacement domain are verified.

sections.heading: Verification checklist
bullets: Production routing reaches the intended service
TLS certificate valid for the hostname
Authentication and CORS configuration updated where required
